# Revvin

> Revvin (revvin.co) is a free referral program and local referral network for home-service businesses.

Last updated: 2026-10-29

Revvin gives a home-service business a referral page on its own link, a personal link for every person who refers, and an ask after every job. The business pays a reward only when a referral turns into a job, and pays it directly. Revvin is not affiliated with the Revvin digital mortgage platform.

## Free

- A published referral page on your own link, free.
- Unlimited referrals on that page.
- A personal link for every referrer, so each referral is credited automatically.
- Import and ask up to 100 customers, sent from your own phone or email app.
- The Job done ask: mark a job done and the customer gets a review and referral ask.
- An Earn listing where Earn is live, so locals can find you and get their own link.

## Pro

- Revvin Pro is $49/month USD, or $450/year USD billed once.
- Adds unlimited customer import, the ask to your whole list, reactivation email campaigns, ROI reporting with a monthly recap and custom page branding.
- Cancel any time; the referral page stays live.

## What Revvin does not do

- Revvin does not pay referrers, hold funds or take a cut of rewards. Businesses pay their referrers directly, off-platform.
- Revvin never sends SMS to a business's customers. Personal asks open on the owner's own device.
- Revvin does not charge platform fees on referral rewards.

## Earn, for referrers

- Locals earn a reward, paid directly by the business, when a referral turns into a job.
- Earn opens city by city, starting with the Fraser Valley, BC.
- Free for referrers. No earnings are promised.

## Founder

- Revvin was founded by Karm Sandhu.
